scenes.text: You are walking up a medieval castle's spiral staircase, thinking you're safe, but you've actually walked right into a deadly architectural trap designed to get you killed.
Almost every castle staircase winds clockwise as you go up, which was a brutal security feature because defending soldiers coming down had their right sword arms completely free to swing.
Meanwhile, you, the attacker, had your right hand constantly blocked by the stone pillar, and to make things worse, the steps were built with uneven heights to make you trip in the dark.
This simple design turned the stairs into a slaughterhouse, so tell me in the comments if you would have survived this trap, and follow for more mind-blowing history secrets.
